title: Control plane: CRUD APIs for SIEM audit export configurations (destinations, credential refs, filters) + validation/audit trail + feature flag
creator: Ethan Park
project: Enterprise Security & Compliance Foundation — SIEM-ready audit export (Beta)
description:
Goal
Implement feature-flagged control-plane APIs to manage “audit export configurations” for SIEM-ready audit export beta. This includes CRUD endpoints, validation, RBAC gating, and an audit trail of config changes (separate from exporting audit events themselves).

Scope
1) Data model + persistence
- New first-class export configuration entity scoped to tenant/workspace.
- Required fields:
  - export_config_id (UUID)
  - tenant_id / workspace_id
  - name (human readable)
  - enabled (bool)
  - destination_type: s3 | splunk_hec | datadog_logs
  - destination_config (opaque per type; stored encrypted-at-rest per existing config DB patterns)
  - credentials_ref (reference to secrets manager entry; do NOT store raw tokens/keys)
  - filter (see Filtering Model ADR; allowlist/denylist by category/action plus optional actor/resource predicates)
  - backfill_window_days (bounded; beta defaults/limits enforced)
  - created_at / updated_at / created_by / updated_by
  - version (monotonic) for optimistic concurrency
- Migration plan: additive only. No changes to existing audit log retention/storage paths.

2) API endpoints (feature-flagged)
- Base: /v1/audit-exports/configs
  - POST   /v1/audit-exports/configs              Create export config
  - GET    /v1/audit-exports/configs              List export configs
  - GET    /v1/audit-exports/configs/{id}         Get export config
  - PATCH  /v1/audit-exports/configs/{id}         Update export config (partial)
  - DELETE /v1/audit-exports/configs/{id}         Delete export config
- Optional convenience actions (implemented as PATCH): enable/disable, rotate credential ref.
- API behaviors:
  - Tenant isolation hard requirement (all queries include tenant scope).
  - Concurrency: If-Match: W/"{version}" supported; reject with 409 on mismatch.
  - Pagination for list.
  - No secrets returned: responses include credentials_ref metadata only (id/name), never secret material.

3) Validation rules
- Global
  - Max configs per tenant (beta): 5 (configurable).
  - name length <= 80; disallow control chars.
  - backfill_window_days: 0–7 for beta (per PRD/retention policy; subject to PM signoff).
- Destination-specific
  - S3: bucket + prefix required; region required; enforce SSE (SSE-S3 or SSE-KMS). If SSE-KMS, require kms_key_arn. Validate bucket name format and prefix normalization.
  - Splunk HEC: validate url scheme https; host allowlist check via shared egress validation library; index/source/sourcetype length bounds.
  - Datadog Logs: validate site parameter (datadoghq.com / datadoghq.eu) and enforce https intake; tags bounds.
- Filter validation
  - Validate categories/actions against schema v2 taxonomy (ENG-5127).
  - Reject known-dangerous filters that would export excessive volume by default (e.g., empty allowlist + no denylist) unless explicitly acknowledged via “include_all_categories=true” (beta: not exposed in UI; internal only).

4) Audit trail of config changes
- Emit canonical audit events on create/update/delete/enable/disable/rotate-credential-ref.
- Event requirements (per schema v2): stable event_id, actor, action, resource, tenant/workspace, and request context where applicable.
- Category: security.audit_export (or final taxonomy chosen in ENG-5127).
- Do NOT include credential values in emitted events or logs; include only credential ref id.

5) RBAC + feature flag
- RBAC gates:
  - audit_export.config:read
  - audit_export.config:write
  - audit_export.credentials:rotate (separate from write)
  - audit_export.status:read (status endpoint is separate ticket, but permission reserved)
- Feature flag: siem_audit_export_beta
  - Enforced at API layer (reject with 404 or 403 based on product decision; we implemented 404 to reduce discoverability).
  - Tenant allowlist handled in ENG-5184; this ticket integrates with flag checks.

Non-scope
- Exporter service implementation, delivery semantics, checkpointing, DLQ (handled in ENG-5139+).
- Status/health endpoint for exporter (handled in separate ticket / PR).
- Console UI (handled in ENG-5177).

References
- PRD: sources/confluence/product-docs/requirements/siem-ready-audit-export-beta-prd.json
- UX spec: sources/confluence/product-docs/design-specs/audit-export-configuration-and-filtering-spec.json
- Schema v2 + mapping: sources/confluence/security-and-compliance/audit-logging/audit-event-schema-v2-and-siem-mapping.json
- Filtering model ADR: sources/confluence/architecture-and-standards/decision-records/adr-audit-export-filtering-model.json
- Delivery semantics ADR (context only): sources/confluence/architecture-and-standards/decision-records/adr-audit-export-delivery-semantics-and-idempotency.json
- API draft notes: sources/google_drive/shared_drives/engineering/platform-engineering/audit-export-config-api-draft-notes.json

Implementation notes (final)
- Storage: export_configs table keyed by (tenant_id, export_config_id). destination_config stored as encrypted blob; server validates fields before encryption.
- Endpoint security: explicit allowlist of fields accepted in PATCH; unknown fields rejected.
- Logging: request logs redact destination_config and credentials_ref details beyond id.
- Errors: consistent error shape with error_code and human message; validation errors return 400 with field-level context.

Acceptance criteria
- CRUD works end-to-end via curl and internal API client.
- Validation covers destination + filter + limits.
- Emits audit events for config mutations (verifiable in internal audit log viewer).
- RBAC enforced with least privilege; no ability for read-only roles to infer secret values.
- Feature flag enforced; disabled tenants cannot call endpoints.

Rollout plan
- Merge behind feature flag.
- Enable for internal alpha tenants first.
- Beta tenant allowlist enablement via internal tooling (ENG-5184) + Support runbook.
